description: Implementation class 'DepositProductReadPlatformServiceImpl' that provides methods for retrieving deposit product data, including all products, specific products by ID, and products with interest chart slabs, for different deposit account types within the Fineract financial platform. It interacts with the database via JDBC and maps result sets to domain data objects.

classes.name: DepositProductReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation class with methods to retrieve deposit product data, utilizing JDBC for database access and mapping result sets to domain objects.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Fetches all deposit products of a specified type.

methods.name: retrieveAllForLookup
methods.description: Fetches deposit products optimized for lookup purposes.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific deposit product by ID and type.

methods.name: retrieveOneWithChartSlabs
methods.description: Retrieves a deposit product along with its interest rate chart slabs.

inner_classes.name: DepositProductMapper
inner_classes.description: Abstract base class for mapping database rows to DepositProductData objects.

inner_classes.name: FixedDepositProductMapper
inner_classes.description: Maps result set rows to FixedDepositProductData objects, including fixed deposit specific fields.

inner_classes.name: RecurringDepositProductMapper
inner_classes.description: Maps result set rows to RecurringDepositProductData objects, including recurring deposit specific fields.

inner_classes.name: DepositProductLookupMapper
inner_classes.description: Maps result set rows to basic deposit product lookup data.
